heading: Presumption of insolvency based on recognition of a foreign main proceeding
source_credit: (Added Pub. L. 109–8, title VIII, §801(a), Apr. 20, 2005, 119 Stat. 144.)

versions.heading: Presumption of insolvency based on recognition of a foreign main proceeding

lines.text: In the absence of evidence to the contrary, recognition of a foreign main proceeding is, for the purpose of commencing a proceeding under section 303, proof that the debtor is generally not paying its debts as such debts become due.
